technology_name: DYNAMIC HEAD LOAD REDISTRIBUTING WEARABLE ROBOT
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Laborers carrying heavy structural loads directly over their heads suffer from dangerous cervical spine compression, balance loss, and early degenerative neck injuries.
description: A specialized head-load redistributing wearable robot exoskeleton built with a dynamic shock-absorbing shoulder pad harness frame, a high-strength upper weight platform, a protective structural helmet node, and a series of mechanical balancing springs.
applications: Manual construction material portage, heavy industrial logistics material handling, military infantry tactical load management, and occupational ergonomic protective gear.
